description: Spare space in the last block is filled first with copies of the transmission's ACK-ONLY D_PDUs, then with PADDING towards a peer known Ed4.
note: As dts-arq/rx-data-acked with 56-byte blocks. Conn 1 binds SAP 9 for ARQ. At 2000 the peer 0.0.1.3 calls with an Ed4 PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST, which records it Ed4 (B-0227, B-0408). At 52000 our accept goes out (type 8, 25 bytes); 31 bytes of the block are spare. No acknowledgement goes in this transmission and its only addressee is recorded Ed4, so PADDING D_PDUs fill it, as many as fit (C-0367, C-0887, C-1154): two, addressed to 0.0.1.3, EOW EMPTY, EOT 10, and 9 bytes are zero filled. The link is made when it ends at 57550. At 61000 the peer's DATA-ONLY with FSN 0 'ping' (EOT 20) is delivered and owes an acknowledgement (C-0174). At 83000 the ACK-ONLY goes (RX LWE 1, bitmap, offset 0, no Ack Data, 15 bytes) and the 41 spare bytes are filled (C-0886, C-1154): first copies of the ACK-ONLY D_PDUs of the transmission, in turn, until one does not fit (C-0369, C-0882): two copies (45 bytes so far, 11 left, a third copy does not fit); then one PADDING D_PDU, which fits exactly. Every D_PDU is in block 0 of 1, so all carry EOT 10. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 56 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500) (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its Ack Data in the header form and 19 bytes plus its Ack Data and CRC-32 in the long form, a PADDING D_PDU 11 bytes. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000 ms (K-0080).
